commands.name: List Running Processes
commands.desc: Enumerates active Windows processes via the EPROCESS double-linked list.

commands.name: Scan for Hidden Processes
commands.desc: Renders process relationships in a tree hierarchy to identify unlinked binaries.

commands.name: Detect Code Injections (Malfind)
commands.desc: Finds memory pages marked PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (PAGE_NOCACHE/VAD allocation).

commands.name: Dump Process Memory
commands.desc: Extracts executable and DLL memory blocks for static analysis.

commands.name: List Active Network Connections with PID
commands.desc: Correlates active sockets to owning PIDs on host.

commands.name: Inspect Scheduled Tasks for Persistence
commands.cmd: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object {$_.State -ne 'Disabled'} | Select-Object TaskName, TaskPath, State
commands.desc: Scans non-standard scheduled tasks configured for persistence.
